QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] The Fox's Forgiveness
QuestInfo.0: Kurama has nothing useful to offer. Perhaps you should speak with Izuna again?
QuestInfo.1: Kurama digs up an old letter and brings it to read to Izuna.
QuestInfo.2: Izuna is in a better mood after listening to Kurama read his letter, and has agreed to be your friend.
